title: Cellular Private Network
description: Configures a private 5G or LTE network.

CellularDataPreferred.title: Cellular data preferred
CellularDataPreferred.description: Set to true to prefer this private network over Wi-Fi.

CsgNetworkIdentifier.title: Csg network identifier
CsgNetworkIdentifier.description:
A string using the 3GPP "CSG_ID" format (defined in 3GPP 23.003, Section 4.7). The device uses this value to match a SIM present on the device.

All combinations of NetworkIdentifier and CsgNetworkIdentifier must be unique across all profiles installed on the device.

DataSetName.title: Data set name
DataSetName.description: The name of the private network configuration data set.

EnableNRStandalone.title: Enable NR standalone
EnableNRStandalone.description: Set to true if this private network is NR Standalone.

Geofences.title: Geofences
Geofences.description: A list of up to 1000 geofences for private networks. Geofencing is only used on iPhone.

GeofenceId.title: Geofence ID
GeofenceId.description: A geofence identifier that's unique within a list of geofences.

Radius.title: Radius
Radius.description: Specifies the radius of the geofence in meters. Set this value slightly greater than the private cellular network coverage area.

NetworkIdentifier.title: Network identifier
NetworkIdentifier.description:
A string using the 3GPP "Coordinated NID" (option 1 or option 2) format (defined in 3GPP 31.102, Section 12.7.1). The device uses this value to match a SIM present on the device.

All combinations of NetworkIdentifier and CsgNetworkIdentifier must be unique across all profiles installed on the device.

VersionNumber.title: Version number
VersionNumber.description: The version number of this dataset that the system uses to track updates.
